_doc: Words for the unit registry (janitor/krew_registry.py): copy to $KREW_HOME/unit-notes.json. A note DESCRIBES a unit (label, what, feeds, off_file, expect, log_check, port, section); it never decides membership: a unit with no note is still watched ('no description yet'), and a note for a unit the machine does not have is reported, never obeyed. `gaps` are open questions the janitor shows until their done-condition (a grep under watch.gaps_root) is met.

krew-janitor.service.label: Janitor
krew-janitor.service.what: every 5 minutes: units, probes, disks, holds; report-only until armed
krew-janitor.service.feeds: the Control Panel's Janitor tile, cards to the board

krew-kanban-loop.service.label: Kanban loop
krew-kanban-loop.service.what: every 20 minutes: greens a try, reframes a repeated failure, retreats a card to the front door

krew-hold-sweep.service.label: Board gate
krew-hold-sweep.service.what: every 2 minutes: routes blocked cards, files reviews, liveness, breakers

steward-sweep.service.label: Steward sweep
steward-sweep.service.what: hourly: one goal card for Steward with the open cards and diagnostics (off by default)

krew-restart-window.service.label: Restart window
krew-restart-window.service.what: every 5 minutes while the owner's off-hours are open: one card, the front door rules, restarts in tier order

krew-window-tick.service.label: Window tick
krew-window-tick.service.what: every 5 minutes: starts the night's jobs from window-schedule.json inside off_hours

krew-ms-nightly.service.label: M&S nightly
krew-ms-nightly.service.what: the machine map and the nightly report; upgrades stay off until ms.yaml says otherwise

krew-dream-night.service.label: Dream night
krew-dream-night.service.what: rolls the day's memory and retains it into Hindsight when one answers

krew-render-window.service.label: Render window
krew-render-window.service.what: every 2 minutes: holds render cards for the off-hours, judges one batch

krew-keeper.service.label: Keeper
krew-keeper.service.what: every minute: health-check every lane in services.json, restart a dead lane it operates

krew-kanban-chatter.service.label: Kanban chatter
krew-kanban-chatter.service.what: every 60 s: board events to the Wall's log roll
krew-kanban-chatter.service.feeds: card comments to the front door

krew-render-collect.service.label: Render collect
krew-render-collect.service.what: every 2 minutes: lands finished ComfyUI takes, scores the ends, unblocks the card
krew-render-collect.service.feeds: renders getting back to their cards

krew-tmp-worktree-reap.service.label: Worktree reap
krew-tmp-worktree-reap.service.what: every 30 minutes: reports (and, when armed, reaps) worktrees left in /tmp

krew-tool-watch.service.label: Front door tool watch
krew-tool-watch.service.what: every 5 minutes: the front door's tool calls, failures and retries; one card when her failure rate jumps (report-only until armed)

krew-wall-tab-probe.service.label: Wall tab probe
krew-wall-tab-probe.service.what: every 2 minutes: does the Wall's page still answer; report only, never reloads

krew-beam-mic-probe.service.label: Beam mic probe
krew-beam-mic-probe.service.what: every minute: the beam mic's source is there and the ear gets a beam angle; one card per 5-minute fault (opt-in)

krew-janitor-watch.service.label: Janitor watch
krew-janitor-watch.service.what: every 10 minutes: the janitor's own tick is fresh, its timer active, its last run ok; one card per episode

krew-janitor-weekly.service.label: Janitor weekly
krew-janitor-weekly.service.what: Monday 08:30: the weekly PROD review card

krew-announce-drain.service.label: Announce drain
krew-announce-drain.service.what: PA lines one at a time through the Wall's player; holds while she is on the air or the ear has a session open

krew-ms-survey.service.label: M&S survey
krew-ms-survey.service.what: every 2 hours: the env manifests and drift between nightly runs (read-only)

krew-architect-collect.service.label: Architect collect
krew-architect-collect.service.what: 06:50 and in the window: the architect notes' collect bundle (no LLM)

krew-team-research-catchup.service.label: Team research catch-up
krew-team-research-catchup.service.what: 02:25: re-runs a research night the window missed

krew-team-sources.service.label: Team sources
krew-team-sources.service.what: monthly: scans the team research sources

krew-decide-sheet-watch.service.label: Decide sheet watch
krew-decide-sheet-watch.service.what: takes his Decide sheet off the Wall when he leaves or a second body enters
krew-decide-sheet-watch.service.feeds: the privacy of the Decide sheet

krew-places-watch.service.label: Places watch
krew-places-watch.service.what: rebuilds the places map seconds after a file lands in a watched folder
krew-places-watch.service.feeds: the front door's docs lookups (where is X?)

krew-restart-window-morning-report.servi.label: Restart window morning report
krew-restart-window-morning-report.servi.what: 07:43: what last night's restart window restarted, held or left owed (read-only)
